content:
General
* Requiring players to handle non-ASCII characters may be too challenging for a Clash of Code, particularly for beginners and for users of certain programming languages. Please consider re-creating your contribution as an Easy puzzle and adjusting the task to make it slightly more challenging.

Game modes
* It's almost impossible to infer the task from the visible tests alone in Reverse mode.

Goal
* Please format all special characters (´, `, etc) as {{constants}}.

Input
* Please rephrase as follows:

<<Line 1>>: A string [[p]] containing a phrase written in either Spanish or Italian.

Output
* Please replace "the phrase" with "[[p]]".

* Please format the three possible outputs as {{constants}}.

Constraints
* Whether the input is a complete sentence doesn't significantly affect the solution. Instead, please specify the minimum and maximum lengths of [[p]].

Stub generator
* Please use the same upper bound as in the Constraints section instead of 264. Would 100 be a more appropriate upper bound?

* Please use the same variable name as in the Input section (i.e. p instead of n).

* Please add a write statement, e.g. write Spanish, Italian or Unclear.

Cases
* To be reviewed once this has been changed to a puzzle.

Thanks.
